questions.topic: Proton Chemical Shift of Aromatic Protons
questions.question: In the context of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the major organic product when Benzene (C₆H₆) reacts under the following conditions: ¹H NMR (400 MHz in CDCl₃)?

options.label: B
options.text: Single sharp singlet at δ = 7.27 ppm (6H)

questions.correct_answer: Single sharp singlet at δ = 7.27 ppm (6H)
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Ring-current magnetic anisotropy strongly deshields aromatic protons, shifting resonance downfield to 7–8 ppm. The correct major product is 'Single sharp singlet at δ = 7.27 ppm (6H)'.

questions.question: In the context of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the major organic product when Acetaldehyde (CH₃CHO) reacts under the following conditions: ¹H NMR (CDCl₃ standard)?

options.label: D
options.text: Downfield quartet at δ = 9.8 ppm (1H) + doublet at δ = 2.2 ppm (3H)

questions.correct_answer: Downfield quartet at δ = 9.8 ppm (1H) + doublet at δ = 2.2 ppm (3H)
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: Strong inductive deshielding by the carbonyl oxygen combined with magnetic anisotropy shifts the aldehyde proton to 9–10 ppm. The correct major product is 'Downfield quartet at δ = 9.8 ppm (1H) + doublet at δ = 2.2 ppm (3H)'.

questions.question: In the context of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the major organic product when Bromoethane (CH₃CH₂Br) reacts under the following conditions: ¹H NMR spectrum acquisition?

options.label: C
options.text: Triplet at δ = 1.6 ppm (3H, J = 7 Hz) + quartet at δ = 3.4 ppm (2H, J = 7 Hz)

questions.correct_answer: Triplet at δ = 1.6 ppm (3H, J = 7 Hz) + quartet at δ = 3.4 ppm (2H, J = 7 Hz)
questions.explanation: Major product rationale: The CH₃ protons split the CH₂ into a quartet (3+1); the CH₂ protons split the CH₃ into a triplet (2+1). The correct major product is 'Triplet at δ = 1.6 ppm (3H, J = 7 Hz) + quartet at δ = 3.4 ppm (2H, J = 7 Hz)'.

questions.question: In the context of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the major organic product when 2-Bromopropane [(CH₃)₂CHBr] reacts under the following conditions: ¹H NMR in CDCl₃?

options.label: A
options.text: Doublet at δ = 1.7 ppm (6H, J = 7 Hz) + septet at δ = 4.3 ppm (1H, J = 7 Hz)

questions.question: In the context of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the major organic product when tert-Butyl methyl ether reacts under the following conditions: ¹H NMR spectroscopy?

questions.question: Which reaction conditions / reagents are required to convert (S)-1,2-Dichloropropane into Diastereotopic C1 protons appear as two distinct non-equivalent doublets of doublets in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy?

questions.question: Which reaction conditions / reagents are required to convert Dichloromethane (CH₂Cl₂) into Single sharp singlet at δ = 5.3 ppm (2H) in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy?
